Risk_Description: Extreme slope SSA breakdown on alpine cliffs (Row 1774, 38.98 deg, 3,586 kPa driving stress) incorrectly accepted due to Newton-Krylov numerical convergence
Impact: Accepting SSA solely because Newton solver minimizes algebraic residual leads to unphysical velocities (>1,500 m/yr) and false mass transport across nunatak headwalls
Mitigation_Strategy: Decouple numerical convergence from physical validity. Implement 3-pillar Physical Applicability Gate: asymptotic threshold |grad s| <= 0.10 rad (~5.71 deg). For Row 1774 (delta = 0.809), mandate 2D vertical Blatter-Pattyn / Full-Stokes cross-section evaluation. Prohibit Gaussian smoothing as physics substitute.
Governance_Gate_Condition: Pillar 1 (convergence) is PREREQUISITE ONLY. Pillar 2 Physical Applicability Gate mandates Higher-Order Blatter-Pattyn / Full-Stokes escalation for all cells with slope > 5.71 deg

Risk_Description: Grounding-line under-resolution on 1 km macro-mesh causing artificial pinning and inaccurate retreat rates
Impact: Model underestimates marine ice sheet instability (MISI) retreat by 30-50% in narrow glacier troughs
Mitigation_Strategy: Mandate 500 m refinement in CAT-1 and CAT-3 (d_GL <= 5 km, 179k cells); implement sub-grid grounding line interpolation (SEP / Schoof flux)
Governance_Gate_Condition: MISMIP+ Ice1r benchmark must match Cornford et al. (2020) within published multi-model envelope

Risk_Description: Spurious mass generation/loss across AMR interfaces or moving grounding-line cell reclassification
Impact: Discrete volume leaks corrupt long-term 2100 sea-level projections and cause non-physical VAF drift (Stage 4.2.2 anomaly)
Mitigation_Strategy: Execute 6-part Synthetic Dynamic Conservation Suite (TEST-1 to TEST-6): exact face flux cancellation (< 1e-15), 2-to-1 AMR metric matching (< 1e-14 kg/s), cut-cell edge scaling, moving GL mass preservation, and closed Leibniz VAF budget (< 1e-6)
Governance_Gate_Condition: Mandatory execution and machine-precision verification of TEST-1 through TEST-6 prior to unconditioned real-data forward runs

Risk_Description: Unconstrained sub-shelf floating ocean drag parameterization introducing artificial friction
Impact: Applying unvalidated ocean drag terms with assumed zero or poorly known ocean currents distorts ice shelf velocity fields
Mitigation_Strategy: Set floating basal traction to exactly zero (tau_b^f = 0.0 Pa) in baseline solver. Retain ocean drag parameterization strictly as documented sensitivity option.
Governance_Gate_Condition: Baseline model strictly enforces tau_b^f = 0.0 Pa; ocean drag sensitivity tested only with coupled ocean circulation

Risk_Description: Double-subtraction of Firn Air Content (FAC) between BedMachine v4.1 and RACMO2.3p2
Impact: Artificial loss of 5-15 m ice thickness across interior plateau, causing ~1,200 km3 systematic volume error
Mitigation_Strategy: Strict mathematical enforcement: BedMachine solid thickness already excludes FAC. RACMO FAC is restricted to altimetric surface adjustments only
Governance_Gate_Condition: Zero double-subtraction rule verified in data loading unit tests

Risk_Description: Calving front back-stress loss causing catastrophic unbuttressed floating shelf acceleration
Impact: Larsen C and George VI ice shelves accelerate to unphysical speeds (>3,000 m/yr) if boundary integral is omitted
Mitigation_Strategy: Implement exact depth-integrated hydrostatic ocean water pressure boundary condition: 0.5 * rho_w * g * (H - s)^2 along all calving front faces
Governance_Gate_Condition: Calving front velocity profile must match observed ITS_LIVE speeds to within 10%

Risk_Description: Temporal mismatch in velocity inversion (merging pre-collapse and post-collapse observations)
Impact: Severe bias in inferred basal friction coefficient C_bed, corrupting dynamic projections
Mitigation_Strategy: Strict epoch separation: post-collapse (2014-2016) for Crane Glacier; decadal composite (2010-2016) for Ryder Glacier
Governance_Gate_Condition: Frozen Ryder parameter C_bed,Hp-I = 8.168e6 Pa*(m/s)^(-1/3) remains unchanged; Crane inversion gated on separate audit

Risk_Description: Polar stereographic map distortion creeping into boundary face flux integrals and true cell area weighting
Impact: Systematic 0.5-3.0% over- or under-estimation of ice discharge across basin boundaries and volume distortion
Mitigation_Strategy: Strict WGS84 single-metric scaling: dA_true = dx*dy / k^2(phi); ds_true = ds_proj / k(phi); ratio k(phi). Verify via Synthetic Conservation TEST-5.
Governance_Gate_Condition: Ellipsoidal volume and mass integrals verified to single-metric invariance (< 1e-14 relative drift)
